title: senecio brassica subsp. brassiciformis
intro: Senecio brassica subsp. brassiciformis, commonly known as Jacob's ladder or woolly Jacob's ladder, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and stress due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The health benefits of Senecio brassica subsp. brassiciformis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include reducing inflammation, soothing respiratory issues, and acting as an anti-spasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant are believed to include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
